tasks.title: innodb_file_per_table make MySQL server crash.

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: 后评提供无需私有数据的最小用例，真正触发条件是极小 sort_buffer_size，可探索目标版相同 InnoDB 索引归并排序路径。

test_spec.setup: InnoDB 表 t1(a varchar(128),b varchar(128),key(a),key(b))，填入 repeat(a,128)/repeat(b,128) 并按原文倍增六次。
test_spec.steps: 按 c231617 设置 session sort_buffer_size=1，执行 force index(a,b) 的 OR LIKE 查询并 ORDER BY a,b，记录变量实际钳制值和执行计划。
test_spec.oracle: 应返回一致行集或受控资源错误，不能服务崩溃；与正常排序缓冲配置对照。
requirements: 记录 SQL mode/实际排序缓冲值
test_spec.target_applicability: InnoDB、双索引 OR 和排序仍是目标功能；旧重复/修复信息不证明当前受影响。

explicit_requirements: 记录 SQL mode/实际排序缓冲值

comments.author: Meiji KIMURA
comments.text:
Description:
I have two innodb tables(apox. 200000-row and 100000-row).
When I joined two tables with specific value, MySQL server down.

I looked into settings. When I don't use 'innodb_file_per_table' for MySQL server, the same SQL works well. So 'innodb_file_per_table' cause this problem, I think.

How to repeat:
I can repeat this problem under the specific environment.
Please contact me about it.

Suggested fix:
[Workaround] 

Don't use 'innodb_file_per_table' for it.

[Suggested fix]

N/A.
